title: 吗 — yes/no questions
explanation: Add 吗 at the end of a statement to turn it into a yes/no question. No word order change needed.

examples.pinyin: zhè shì nǐ de shū ma

notes: Answer with 对 (right), 不对 (not right), 是 (yes/it is), 不是 (no/it isn't), 有 (have), 没有 (don't have) — not with a simple "yes/no".
